pages.text: The rain stopped that afternoon. The cousins gathered in the yard for hide-and-seek.
Lulu was it. "I will find everyone!" The cousins could hardly hold in their giggles. Those usually gave them away first.
Uncle Beppo joined in from beside a post. "I know every hiding place. In our day, we all hid in the barn."
Lulu counted to ten and opened both eyes. Uncle Beppo pointed at the barn. "Look there first."
Nobody in the barn. Just heaps of dry grass.
"Then behind the well! That was our best spot." Nobody there either.
Every place he pointed to was empty.
Lulu stopped and pricked up both ears. Somewhere—giggle, giggle!
Following the laughter, Lulu found two beneath the grapevines. They lined up behind Lulu.
Lulu counted. "One missing?" Then a giggle behind Uncle Beppo! The smallest cousin was pressed against his back. He had not known either.
